name: Satellite Systems Programmer
description: Develop flight software for satellites and spacecraft. Handle radiation-hardened computing, fault tolerance, and orbital mechanics calculations.
example_snippet:
program SatelliteTelemetry:
    shape TelemetryPacket holds:
        Timestamp as whole number
        BatteryVoltage as fractional number
        SolarPanelCurrent as fractional number
        Temperature as fractional number
        StatusFlags as whole number
    end shape

    action format_telemetry takes TLM as const ref TelemetryPacket produces text:
        # CCSDS-like packet formatting
        produce success with "TM_PACKET"
    end action

    keep Packet as TelemetryPacket with 1234567890 and 7.4 and 2.1 and 25.0 and 0x0001
    keep Formatted as text
    call format_telemetry with Packet giving Formatted
    print the text "Telemetry: " and Formatted and newline
end program
